title: Release Canopy: unified preflight audit runner for release validation
creator: Maya Chen
description: Implement 'Release Canopy', a unified preflight audit runner that consolidates smoke probes, performance regression gates, and eval-suite comparisons for release candidates. The runner should be LTS-aware (different gating for LTS vs non-LTS releases), support multi-model variant comparisons (fp16 / int8 / quantized variants), and produce a machine-readable attestation and human-readable audit summary suitable for SRE/PM sign-off.
acceptance_criteria: Canary smoke battery runs automatically for every release candidate and returns pass/fail within configured SLOs
Perf regression gates compute token-latency and p95/99 deltas vs baseline and block release when > configured thresholds
Eval-suite executes prompt sets (sanity, edge-case, hallucination) and reports quality deltas; failure triggers a rollback or manual review workflow
Output includes signed attestations (run_id + artifact links) that can be attached to release notes
Runner can be executed in hosted CI and in Private deployments with the same config and policy definitions
plan: Phase 1 (2 sprints): prototype 'canopy-run' CLI and GitHub Action for smoke + perf probes; wire in KV-cache and batching knobs so preflight can exercise runtime optimizations. Phase 2 (2 sprints): integrate eval-suite harness, LTS policy matrix, and attestation generator. Phase 3: roll out as gating step in release pipeline and add observability dashboard in Console.
test_matrix_summary: Smoke probes: 20 sanity endpoints (api/stream/embeddings), run at 5 seq lengths; Perf gates: baseline vs candidate across cpu/gpu/quantized variants measuring p50/p95/p99 latency, throughput and token cost; Eval suite: 150 prompt pairs across reasoning, summarization, and instruction-following with automated similarity + quality heuristics. Each run emits metrics and artifacts to S3 + Console trace link.
rollout_strategy: Start opt-in for non-LTS branches using a soft-fail policy (alert + allow), then progressively enforce hard-fail for LTS branch releases after one stabilization cycle. Use a canary population of 5% traffic to sanity-check production-like signals before full rollout. Provide a manual override path in Console with audit logging.
progress_updates: 2026-02-22: Spike completed — prototype CLI scaffolding and smoke probe harness. Verified smoke probes against staging models.
2026-03-02: Perf gate prototype integrated with existing perf harness; initial delta computation (p95) implemented; discovered noise when sampling < 1000 tokens across small models.
2026-03-08: Design review with PM + SRE; agreed on LTS gating matrix and soft/hard thresholds. Added requirement for signed attestation artifacts.
2026-03-12: GitHub PR #8421 opened for canopy-run CLI and action; integration tests running in CI; initial console trace links surfaced in artifacts bucket.
2026-03-14: UX feedback from Console team — add explicit 'escalation playbook' link to audit summary. Action item created to add runbook reference.
review_feedback: PM (Sofia Rasmussen): prefer conservative thresholds for first LTS enforcement window and require manual sign-off for model-quantization changes.
SRE (Diego Morales): want the runner to emit structured SLO signals (prometheus labels) and a separate health-check endpoint for heartbeat monitoring.
Design (Eve Nakamura): audit summary needs a compact visual diff of latency vs token-cost to help swift triage.
Security (Liam O'Connor): verify attestation signing key storage — integrate with KMS/HSM in Private deployments.
blockers: Intermittent perf noise when sampling < 1k tokens causing false positives — investigating aggregation/bootstrapping strategy
KMS integration for signing artifacts in Private deployments requires coordination with Security team — dependency on ENG-501212 completion
risks_and_tradeoffs: Tight perf thresholds risk false negatives for small models or noisy benchmarks; mitigations include adaptive sample sizing and multi-run bootstrap aggregation. Requiring signed attestations increases operational complexity for Private customers; will provide a relaxed mode that records unsigned artifacts for initial adoption.
next_steps: Finish PR #8421 integration tests and merge; add multi-run bootstrap aggregation to perf gate module
Implement Prometheus labels and heartbeat endpoint per SRE feedback
Wire KMS attestation signing in staging (coordinate with ENG-501212)
Add escalation runbook link to Console audit summary and ship updated UX copy
